mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (code, user_id, type, content, contact, status, gmt_create, gmt_modify) VALUES (#{code}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{contact}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.code, f.user_id, f.type, f.content, f.contact, f.status, f.handle_remark, f.handle_by, f.handle_time, f.gmt_create, f.gmt_modify, u.name AS user_name, u.doorplate AS user_doorplate, u.mobile AS user_mobile FROM feedback f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.id WHERE f.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET status = 1, handle_remark = #{handleRemark}, handle_by = #{handleBy}, handle_time = NOW(), gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0

INSERT INTO feedback_images (feedback_code, image_id, create_by, create_time) VALUES
(#{feedbackCode}, #{imageId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT fi.feedback_code AS marketCode, fi.image_id AS id, f.url FROM feedback_images fi LEFT JOIN images f ON fi.image_id = f.id WHERE fi.feedback_code = #{feedbackCode} ORDER BY fi.create_time ASC
